name: Environment Southland / Southland Regional Council
story: Environment Southland participated in and co-sponsored Topoclimate South’s regional soil and microclimate mapping programme in 1998–2001. Its institutional strategy maps explicitly credit ES GIS in 2001. Documented work also includes GIS mapping for pest management that year.
